_comment: Macro block for the owner-subject article. HUMAN-MAINTAINED. Every stat carries its own source and date. The generator REFUSES to render the macro section if as_at is older than max_age_days -- a stale macro block silently misrepresents the market, so it fails loud instead. Update after each monthly Cotality release / RBA decision.

stats.text: Cotality's five-city aggregate fell -0.9% in July 2026 and -2.0% over the July quarter, with Sydney down -3.7%, Melbourne down -3.0% and Brisbane down -0.1%
The RBA cash rate stands at 4.35%, raised in February, March and May 2026 and held at the 16 June meeting
Headline CPI rose 3.8% over the year to June 2026 and the trimmed mean 3.6%
The Westpac-Melbourne Institute House Price Expectations Index fell -8% in July 2026 to a three-year low, though 47% of respondents still expected rises

auction_note.text: the capital-city average clearance rate was 46.0% for the week ending 5 July 2026, with Brisbane at 23.5%
auction_note.caveat: homes in these suburbs sell predominantly by private treaty, so that figure measures a different sale process
